Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.
I’ll build the scene with inline SVG, CSS, and JavaScript, using warm lighting, drifting steam, and subtle mouse response to bring the ramen to life.

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1440,'height':1000}, device_scale_factor=1)
        errors = []
        page.on('pageerror', lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
        await page.goto('http://<LAN_IP>:8000', wait_until='networkidle')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        await page.screenshot(path='<TMP>/ramen-desktop.png')
        print({'errors':errors,'body_scroll':await page.evaluate('({w:document.body.scrollWidth,h:document.body.scrollHeight,vw:innerWidth,vh:innerHeight})'),'elements':await page.locator('svg *').count()})
        await page.mouse.move(1300,330)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        print('Pointer response:',await page.locator('.portrait').evaluate('(element)=>getComputedStyle(element).transform'))
        await page.set_viewport_size({'width':390,'height':844})
        await page.mouse.move(0,0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(700)
        await page.screenshot(path='<TMP>/ramen-mobile.png')
        await page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(200)
        await page.screenshot(path='<TMP>/ramen-reduced.png')
        print('Reduced motion:',await page.evaluate('({transform:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".portrait")).transform,animation:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".soup-glow")).animationName})'))
        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())

        await page.mouse.move(1350,340)

        await page.mouse.move(720,450)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(600)

        await page.set_viewport_size({'width':390,'height':844})

        print('Errors:',errors,'Requests:',requests,flush=True)
